summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated August 5, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results, increased 2026 production guidance, a 50% dividend increase, and the successful completion of the Orla Mining merger on July 31, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings and operational update, noting the merger's completion but not announcing a new special-situation event. The merger itself was previously announced and the filing contains no transactional terms, premiums, or tender offer details. This is a standard current report.
